instruction: Board Outline to Raspberry Pi HAT+ The file board.kicad_pcb is an 85x56 mm rectangular PCB with a 2x20 GPIO header (J1) and no mounting holes. The file /home/user/Desktop/spec.txt points to the Raspberry Pi HAT+ form factor. Modify the board to comply with the Raspberry Pi HAT+ mechanical specification. Replace the rectangular Edge.Cuts outline with the HAT+ outline: 65x56.5 mm with R=3 mm rounded corners. Add 4 M2.5 mounting holes at the HAT+ positions. Move the GPIO header to the HAT+ required location. Requirements: 1. Edge.Cuts bounding box: width = 65 mm +/- 0.05, height = 56.5 mm +/- 0.05. 2. Exactly 4 gr_arc elements on Edge.Cuts, each with radius approx 3 mm (+/- 0.1 mm). 3. 4 mounting hole footprints at positions (3.5,3.5), (61.5,3.5), (3.5,53.0), (61.5,53.0) +/- 0.05 mm. 4. GPIO header J1 at (29.0, 52.5) +/- 0.1 mm. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
